title: Use Group VIII – additional provisions for parking requirement category
previewText: For permitted uses denoted with “*” for parking requirement category (PRC) in Section 42-181 (Use Group VIII – general use allowances), the following provisions shall apply. Amusement or recreation facilities or select entertainment facilities that are enclosed shall be classified as PRC B1. Such uses that are unenclosed shall be classified as PRC C.
